$description: Human/design-owner-approved baseline for brand-critical tokens. This file is the SOLE source of truth for what value a protected token is allowed to hold. Approving a change means a human deliberately editing this file's 'approvedValue' for that entry, in its own commit, BEFORE the corresponding token-source change is synced or committed — not in the same automated run that proposes the change. scripts/figma-sync.mjs, scripts/figma-snapshot-import.mjs and figma-plugin/ (the plugin and its local bridge) must never create or write to this file — enforced structurally (this file is not part of any script's writable file list) and re-checked at runtime after every apply (see scripts/figma-sync.mjs's post-apply assertion) and in CI (scripts/validate-no-self-approval.mjs rejects any figma-sync/* branch that modifies this file). There is no environment-variable or command-line bypass. See ai/token-guardrails.md for the full policy writeup, the mutation-order guarantee, and root-cause history.
